description: This Java source file defines the 'FeaturePropertyDeleted' event class, representing an event emitted when a property of a feature in a thing has been deleted. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, retrieving event details, and serialization.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyDeleted
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the deletion of a property within a feature of a thing in the Eclipse Ditto platform.

methods.name: of

methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the location of the deleted property.
